name: Amahane Chiyoko
source:
Self proclaimed high tension mascot character of the dorm, Choko is the eccentric moodmaker of the group and has a wide range of hobbies. She is as random as she is bipolar, dropping hobbies as fast as CB players drop tears on their gararolls, recently got into making haikus.

[From [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2011/07/21/sukima-zakura-to-uso-no-machi-review/]Warum's review[/url]]
